fields.System.Title: FDN-403 — Partition the audit table
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a developer, I want the audit table partitioned by month, so that its growth never
degrades the rest of the database.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given the audit table, then it is partitioned by month with partitions created ahead
  • of time.
  • - Given a query filtered by date, then it reads only the relevant partitions.
  • - Given a partition older than the retention window, then it can be detached and
  • archived without locking current writes.
  • - Given the partitioning migration, then it runs against production-sized data within
  • the deployment window.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | platform |
| Tables | audit_log |
| Risks | Audit growth taking the database down ([doc 04 §3.1](../../../docs/04-modules.md)); migration untested at scale ([doc 09 §11.5](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | migration (at production scale) · integration |
